Transaction cancel, publish, root advance, clear, and verify operations for accdb.

# Purpose
This C file implements administrative operations for an `fd_accdb_admin_t` database handle that wraps a `fd_funk_t` storage engine. It provides join and leave functions, transaction control, record cleanup, and database reset and verification entry points. The code manages the life cycle of the shared-memory database state, including attaching child transactions, cancelling a transaction tree, advancing the root transaction, clearing all transactions and records, and checking internal consistency with [`fd_accdb_verify`](<#fd_accdb_verify>).

The main technical work in the file is transaction and record graph maintenance. Functions such as [`fd_accdb_txn_cancel_one`](<#fd_accdb_txn_cancel_one>), [`fd_accdb_txn_cancel_tree`](<#fd_accdb_txn_cancel_tree>), [`fd_accdb_txn_publish_one`](<#fd_accdb_txn_publish_one>), and [`fd_accdb_advance_root`](<#fd_accdb_advance_root>) update transaction state, remove records from hash maps, free pool objects, and repair parent and sibling links in the fork tree. The file also contains helper routines for garbage collection of root records and for full cleanup of transaction and record lists during [`fd_accdb_clear`](<#fd_accdb_clear>).
